reservation: Reserve buy notional plus fee at decision, atomically with decision. Pending reservations reduce cash and remaining cost exposure. Recheck marked exposure and symbol constraints at fill. Release on fill/rejection/expiry.
position_cost: Gross acquisition cost including buy fee; partial sell removes proportional cost, realized PnL is net proceeds minus removed cost.
sharing: One policy and one synthetic account. No CF/GROWTH shared capital or connection to existing runtime/authority.
